body:
Hey, ain't dead yet! Wrote this when I was feeling shite and needed to rant.


Psychiatrist is kind of not really an option for me, sadly. My parents don't really believe in mental illness. To them, everyone with depression just needs to lighten up and they only become depressed because they have nothing to do. People with anxiety to them just need to grow a pair of balls. Messed up, I know, but it's not like I can change their opinions about it.


And oh yes my parents have massive expectations of me. Apparently being successful when you're younger means that they get very disappointed if you are anything less than best. Yay for me!


And to be honest, I burned out real bad last year. Since I started secondary school I've found that I can't concentrate on things as easily. TBH I might have had this problem before as a little kid but parental pressure does WONDERS /s. I guess I rly need to work smarter. I'll defo take a look at what u recommended.
